Petey's seeded crackers and herb cream
for Petey, whose head has fallen off

Homemade seeded crackers loaded with sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, with a cream cheese whipped with chives, dill and lemon for dipping. Mix 60g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 30g chia seeds, 60g plain flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil and 200ml water. Stand 15 minutes, then spread very thin between sheets of baking paper. Bake at 160C for 45 minutes, peel off the top sheet, and bake 15 minutes more until crisp. Snap into shards. Beat 250g cream cheese with chopped chives, dill, lemon zest and pepper.
M: spiked for Sea Bass, mild for you
Beef patty griddled with cheddar, topped with beef chilli and pickled jalapeños. Keep a jar of hot sauce for anyone who wants Sea Bass's version.
Aspen room service surf and turf
lobster and the works on someone else's money

Grilled lobster tails in garlic parsley butter beside seared sirloin, with crunchy double-cooked chips and a bowl of béarnaise to share. Cut 800g potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then at 190C for 3 minutes. Split 4 lobster tails and brush with 60g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and parsley, then grill flesh side up 6 to 8 minutes. Season 4 small sirloin steaks and sear 3 minutes a side, then rest. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar over simmering water, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter and chopped tarragon. Serve together.
W: Vanilla sugar cookies cut into snowflakes, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white with silver cachous.
K: Aspen ski lodge after the slopes

s.note: Potato chips, cheese puffs and dog bone pretzels for the road.
s.how: Tip 60g potato chips, 60g cheese puffs and 60g dog-bone-shaped pretzels into a big shared bowl. Toss gently and share between four people for the road trip.

s.note: Thick buttermilk soaked onion rings in puffed golden beer batter.
s.how: Slice 2 brown onions into thick rings and soak in 150ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Whisk 120g plain flour with 150ml cold lager and 1/4 tsp salt. Drain the onions, dip in the batter and fry in small batches in neutral oil at 185°C for 3 to 4 minutes until puffed and golden. Drain and salt lightly.

m.note: Beef patty with cheddar, beef chilli and pickled jalapeños.
m.how: Brown 200g beef mince with 1 diced onion in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1/2 tsp cumin, 200g chopped tinned tomatoes and 100ml water. Simmer 25 minutes until thick and season. Shape another 500g beef mince into four patties. Griddle over medium-high heat for about 4 minutes per side until cooked through, checking 75°C at the centre. Top with 80g cheddar to melt. Toast 4 burger buns and fill with patties, chilli and 40g pickled jalapeños. Put 40ml hot sauce on the table for anyone wanting the extra-hot version.

w.note: Vanilla sugar cookies with white icing and silver cachous.
w.how: Beat 80g softened butter with 60g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 1 egg yolk and 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, then mix in 130g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll 5mm thick and cut into 8 snowflakes. Bake at 180°C conventional for 8 minutes until pale gold at the edges. Cool completely. Mix 80g icing sugar with 2 to 3 tsp water to a spreadable white icing, coat the cookies and decorate with 10g edible silver cachous. Serve two each.

d.note: Frothy dark chocolate milk with whipped cream and marshmallows.
d.how: Heat 600ml full cream milk until steaming, without boiling. Add 100g dark chocolate and whisk until melted and frothy. Divide among four mugs. Softly whip 80ml thickened cream, spoon on top and finish with 40g marshmallows.
